# Kaptiono

> Kaptiono is a privacy-first AI subtitle generator and caption editor for creators. It supports Local Whisper transcription in the browser and an optional Cloud High Accuracy mode.

Current stable release: v1.0.0.

The original video stays on the user's device. Local Whisper models process audio on-device. When Cloud High Accuracy is explicitly selected, only the extracted audio required for transcription is sent through the Kaptiono Cloud transcription service. Caption editing and video export remain local.

## Product

- [Kaptiono](https://kaptiono.com/): Production AI subtitle application and PWA.
- [About Kaptiono](https://kaptiono.com/about/): Product overview, Local versus Cloud processing, features, privacy, device support and FAQ.
- [Partners](https://kaptiono.com/partners/): Partnership and sponsorship opportunities for creator tools, hardware, software and brands serving video creators.
